## Overview

**Sophie** was the test subject designated **Number 241** at the Flesh Architects' laboratory. She was held captive alongside **Zan (Subject 242)** during his two years of experimentation (ages 11 to 13). In the short intervals of silence between tortures, they healed each other's wounds. Their shared horrors forged an unbreakable connection -- a pure and profound love born in the ugliest place imaginable.

Sophie was the only reason Zan's mind did not completely shatter when the B Crystals burned his soul during the Catalyst Project.

---

## Status

Sophie's current whereabouts and fate are **unknown**. When Zan escaped at age 13, he was unable to find or free her. She may still be held by the Flesh Architects, or she may have been moved, sold, or killed in the years since.

Zan's quest to gather power and resources is driven in large part by his determination to return to the Flesh Architects' facilities, destroy them, and rescue Sophie -- if she is still alive.

---
